title: Raid Planning
warm:
Hangar raid planning put [player_name] at a Crownspire table with or against Marcus Pell while Nolan Greer's silence sat like a third chair. Soft alibi had become logistics. Detective Imani Brooks's colder file made dawn windows feel like deadlines. Vivienne's fate stayed four open doors—no settled body, no settled exit.

"Hold the soft story through the raid," Pell said, fixer calm. "Or go public enough that politics burn him clean or dirty. Inquiry follows either way if the neighbor-mistress stays in frame."

[player_name]—early thirties, across the hall—felt Nolan's cufflink patience across the glass. Rhea's ash. Perfume twin memory. Black car maps. Choice: walk into inquiry as closeness under review, or go public enough to protect or burn him. Soft was no longer only hallway silk; it was a raid variable.

Wind sheer. Elevator chime. Hope and dread shared the plans.

Raid maps made soft alibi look like a checkbox. [player_name] listened to Pell translate neighbor-mistress into operational risk while Nolan's silence across glass said he would accept either inquiry heat or public burn if she chose it. Crownspire dawn windows refused to soften deadlines.

Hangar raid with or against the fixer meant logistics wearing dread. Vivienne still four open doors. Brooks still climbing without a body. Soft still a variable: hold it through the raid, or go public enough that politics did what silence could not.

She catalogued anchors—elevator, perfume memory, black car, cufflinks, Rhea's ash, wind sheer—and refused to stack them into elegant absolutes. Dialogue had carried the cost; anchors kept score. Choice verbs: inquiry closeness under review, or public-enough protect-or-burn.

Hope and dread shared the table.
hot:
Raid planning left [player_name]'s body humming under professional language—early thirties wanting Nolan Greer's hands while Pell inventoried soft cover as asset. Mid-want inappropriate at a strategy table. Four fates open. Brooks without corpse. Crime plot; heat a private throb.

She could choose inquiry closeness—or public-enough politics—while thighs stayed tight for the man whose cufflinks waited across glass. Romance locked. Mid-want ending over maps. She trembled choosing which verb got dawn.

Strategy-table want was cruel—professional words over a private throb. Soft alibi mid-want while Pell planned made her feel litigated and touched without hands. She could walk inquiry as closeness with her body still voting Nolan—or go public enough while unfinished desire still cast a dirty ballot.

Romance locked. Crime plot. Unfinished over maps on purpose.
